corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: GALLUS, Steward and Durin accumulate patrol damage. Lava covers the final western passage after frame 4950. Require patrol death before its exit; no assumed blocking of this flying enemy.
GALLUS clears roadblock #3 and Plume clears roadblock #1. Confirm safe arrival; ordinary operators neither attack nor block the civilian.
Fang and GALLUS handle the opening upper central enemies. Spot closes the later corridor at [3,3]; Lava supplies upper armor damage and Hibiscus heals.
Noir Corne handles opening lower central enemies. Cardigan assumes later three-block defense, with Steward attacking and Ansel healing.
Plume handles opening upper outer enemies and western clearance. Beagle closes the vacancy before route-17 arrivals and remains through final clearance.
Midnight handles opening and paired lower outer officers with Ansel healing and Steward approach damage. Melantha closes the later vacancy and retains the final corridor.
Midnight clears roadblock #2; Steward clears roadblock #4. Lower approach damage and interception limit officer exposure, but do not establish immunity. Require the second civilian's safe arrival.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Opening upper central interception and conditional automatic DP.
Early upper eastern roadblock damage, upper interception support and later patrol damage.
Upper western roadblock clearance and opening upper outer interception.
Opening lower outer interception and lower western roadblock clearance.
Deployment heal and temporary healing for Fang and Plume.
Lower interception healing, later covering Cardigan, Steward and Melantha.
Upper western healing, later covering Beagle, Spot and Lava.
Lower eastern roadblock clearance, lower patrol exposure and permanent lower armor damage.
Eastern patrol damage across its upper section.
Permanent upper central three-block defense without unsupported healing.
Permanent lower central three-block defense without unsupported self-healing.
Final western patrol interception by arts damage and permanent upper central damage; no splash credit.
Permanent lower outer damage and interception under Ansel.

formation_structure.battery: Steward covers the lower eastern circuit, Durin the upper eastern circuit, and GALLUS the upper horizontal exposure. Attack selection remains uncontrolled.
formation_structure.final: Beagle and Melantha hold outer corridors; Spot and Cardigan hold central corridors. Hibiscus heals the upper western formation; Ansel heals the lower formation. Lava clears upper armor and Steward clears lower armor.
formation_structure.opening: Four separate corridors receive blockers. GALLUS supplies early upper damage; Lancet bridges upper healing, and Ansel arrives before the previous lower outer collapse can be repeated unchecked.
formation_structure.temporary_vacancies: Upper outer is vacant from 92 to 120 seconds, upper central from 120 to 137 seconds, lower central from 137 to 142.5 seconds, and lower outer from 142.5 to 178 seconds. These are model timing hypotheses requiring cleared predecessors and closure before the next hostile passes.

formation_transitions.transition: Replace Lancet with Hibiscus on the same tile, facing LEFT. Fang subsequently relies on GALLUS-assisted clearance until retirement; Hibiscus does not cover Fang at [3,5].
Withdraw Plume after upper western clearance and opening outer kills; use the released slot for Durin.
Withdraw Fang after upper central clearance and its fifth expected grant; deploy Beagle on the vacant upper outer tile.
Withdraw Noir Corne after lower central clearance; deploy Spot farther west in the upper central corridor.
Withdraw Midnight only after both lower outer officers are dead and the western restraint is destroyed; deploy Cardigan before the approaching lower central officer passes [4,5].
Withdraw GALLUS and Durin after their useful eastern exposures; deploy Lava to cover the patrol's remaining western passage.
Deploy Melantha before the next lower outer officer reaches [6,3].

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Use only listed catalog operators with rarity 1-3 and normal_mode true. Every deployment uses an allowed terrain tile and explicit direction.
Never deploy on these exact row-column tiles.
Never exceed eight deployed operators. Same-frame retirements precede their replacement deployments.
Budget natural DP and exactly five conditional Fang grants. No refunds, kill DP or unsupported effects are assumed. Under those conditions the final deployment at 178 seconds has zero DP margin.
Every required source must survive until its scheduled skill or retirement. An absent source invalidates the candidate; static deployability does not prove survival.

Upper eastern restraint must be destroyed before GALLUS retires; upper western restraint before Plume retires; lower western restraint before Midnight retires. Lower eastern release must precede lethal combined civilian pressure.

Each temporarily vacated corridor must have no surviving predecessor, and its replacement must intercept the next hostile before it passes. The narrow lower central handoff requires explicit timing verification.
The patrol must die before reaching its exit. Lava's western coverage is a finishing responsibility, not proof that the earlier battery supplied sufficient damage.
Do not target or block civilians with ordinary operators. Require two safe arrivals and zero protected-target deaths; neither roadblock release nor artillery death alone proves protection.
Accept only remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected deaths and both expected protected targets safely arrived. Operator deaths are recorded separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Establish all four interception duties, start both upper restraint attacks, and deploy Lancet after damage has occurred.
Ansel must preserve Midnight through artillery and melee pressure. Hibiscus assumes upper western healing. Complete upper restraint clearance before prolonged civilian exposure.
Steward clears the lower eastern restraint while contributing available patrol damage. Durin and GALLUS cover upper patrol exposure. Close the upper outer vacancy before incoming officers.
Execute the central defender handoffs without passing enemies. Preserve the three-caster battery and both physicians; clear the lower outer predecessors before withdrawing Midnight.
Lava finishes any remaining western patrol HP and then attacks upper central enemies. Melantha closes the lower outer vacancy. Three-block central defenders absorb paired raiders.

Continue blocking, healing and armor clearance until all scheduled spawns are exhausted, no hostile remains, both civilians have arrived safely, zero leaks and zero protected deaths are recorded, and remaining life is positive.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic grants expected at 19, 44, 69, 94 and 119 seconds only if Fang survives and remains deployed. No later grants or refunds are budgeted.
Accelerate western restraint clearance and any remaining opening duel.
First activation has a one-second preparation margin: deployment at 37 seconds gives 71 SP at 78 seconds. Use arts damage for western clearance and outer combat.
Strengthen lower healing, with the second activation delayed to cover the central handoff and late patrol pressure. Baseline range covers assigned lower allies.
Strengthen upper western healing. Hold the second ready activation until Lava's deployment to support the western patrol finish.
Reduce physical damage during outer officer accumulation and cleanup.
First activation follows eleven seconds of preparation including the supported deployment SP bonus; later activations respect active-duration SP pauses. Credit single-target arts damage only.
Shorten final lower outer duels under Ansel's healing.
Use supported automatic enhanced attacks; assume neither highest-defense priority nor player-directed targeting.
No healing skill, evasion or unsupported talent responsibility.
No self-healing skill or unsupported HP talent responsibility.

tactical_thesis: Establish healing substantially earlier, clear the first civilian's two restraints with separate attackers, and retain three complementary arts attackers through the eastern patrol circuit. Use temporary vacancies between outer waves to replace fragile central holders. Lava then covers the patrol's final western passage and upper armor clearance. This is an unverified fixed candidate; survival, clearance deadlines and vacancy closure are falsifiable dependencies.
